botReason_anonymous_picture.description: The account uses the default grey avatar instead of a profile photo.

botReason_balanced_audience.description: The follower / following ratio looks like a real person's. Counts in the account's favour.

botReason_digit_heavy.description: The username contains an unusually high proportion of digits.

botReason_empty_name.description: The account has no full name / display name set.

botReason_follows_far_more.description: The account follows many more accounts than follow it back.

botReason_has_badge.description: The account carries a badge from Instagram. Counts in the account's favour.

botReason_mass_following.description: The account follows an extremely large number of accounts.

botReason_no_followers.description: The account has no followers at all.

botReason_posts_regularly.description: The account posts regularly. Counts in the account's favour.

botReason_trailing_digits.description: The username ends with a run of digits, e.g. user82736.

botReason_underscore_run.description: The username has an unusual pattern of underscores.

botReason_verified.description: The account carries Instagram's verified badge. Counts in the account's favour.

botReason_very_long_username.description: The username is far longer than a person normally chooses.
